statements.status_notes: h2 0.4.15 is a transitive dependency embedded in the uv/uvx binaries from the DHI uv package. GHSA-q83h-524g-xf6h is fixed in h2 0.4.16. Remediation requires the uv package to bump its Cargo lock to h2 0.4.16 or later, publishing a new DHI uv package, and rebuilding sbx-templates against it.

h2 0.4.15 is a transitive dependency embedded in the uv/uvx binaries from the DHI uv package. GHSA-q83h-524g-xf6h is fixed in h2 0.4.16. Remediation requires the uv package to bump its Cargo lock to h2 0.4.16 or later, publishing a new DHI uv package, and rebuilding sbx-templates against it.

GHSA-q83h-524g-xf6h is fixed in h2 0.4.16 with no backport on the 0.3.x line. actix-http 3.12.1 (used by meilisearch) requires h2 ^0.3.27; cargo update to h2 0.4.16 fails with 'failed to select a version for the requirement h2 = ^0.3.27'. The separate h2 0.4.x dependency tree is bumped to 0.4.16 in the image build. Waiting for actix-http to adopt h2 0.4.x or for upstream meilisearch to migrate off actix-http 3.12.x.

h2 0.3.27 is pulled only by console-subscriber via tonic 0.9.x. console-subscriber is an optional dependency behind the tokio_console feature, which is not enabled in the release cargo build (cargo build --release without --features tokio_console). The vulnerable h2 0.3.x code is therefore not compiled into the shipped influxdb3 binary.

GHSA-q83h-524g-xf6h is patched only in h2 0.4.16. Vector 0.57.0 pulls h2 0.3.26 transitively through hyper 0.14.32 (requires h2 ^0.3.24), so cargo cannot select 0.4.16 for that dependency chain. The h2 0.4.x instances in the build are bumped to 0.4.16 separately.
